source_idea: I need a simple task manager for my studies. I want to add tasks with a title, an optional description, a due date, a priority (low, medium, high) and a status (to do, in progress, done). I should be able to see all my tasks, search them by title, filter by status, edit them and delete the ones I no longer need.

app.name: Task Manager
app.description: A single-user web app to create, track, update and delete personal tasks with due dates, priority and status.

entities.name: Task
entities.label: Task
entities.description: A piece of work the user needs to do.

functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow the user to create a Task by entering: Title, Description, Due date, Priority, Status.
The system shall display all Tasks in a list showing Title, Due date, Priority, Status, sorted by Due date, with search by Title and filters by Status, Priority.
The system shall allow the user to edit any field of an existing Task and save the changes.
The system shall allow the user to delete a Task after confirming the action in a confirmation dialog.

The system shall reject saving a Task unless: Title is filled in, Title has at least 3 characters, Title has at most 100 characters, Description has at most 1000 characters, Due date is today or later, Priority is filled in, Status is filled in.
The system shall save all records in browser localStorage so they remain after the page is reloaded.

user_stories.benefit: I can keep a record of it

user_stories.goal: view and search the list of Tasks
user_stories.benefit: I can find the record I need

user_stories.goal: delete a Task I no longer need
user_stories.benefit: the list only contains relevant records

acceptance_criteria.given: the Tasks list is open with N records
acceptance_criteria.when: the user fills in Title = "Prepare sprint report", Priority = "high", Status = "to_do" and clicks "Save"
acceptance_criteria.then: a Task named "Prepare sprint report" appears in the list and the list shows N + 1 records

acceptance_criteria.given: the create Task form is open
acceptance_criteria.when: the user leaves all fields empty and clicks "Save"
acceptance_criteria.then: no Task is saved and an error message is shown next to each required field: Title, Priority, Status

acceptance_criteria.given: the create Task form is open and all other fields are valid
acceptance_criteria.when: the user enters the 2-character value "ab" in "Title" and clicks "Save"
acceptance_criteria.then: the Task is not saved and an error message is shown next to "Title"

acceptance_criteria.given: the create Task form is open and all other fields are valid
acceptance_criteria.when: the user enters a text of 1001 characters in "Description" and clicks "Save"
acceptance_criteria.then: the Task is not saved and an error message is shown next to "Description"

acceptance_criteria.given: the create Task form is open and all other fields are valid
acceptance_criteria.when: the user enters yesterday's date in "Due date" and clicks "Save"
acceptance_criteria.then: the Task is not saved and an error message is shown next to "Due date"

acceptance_criteria.given: a Task named "Prepare sprint report" was created
acceptance_criteria.then: "Prepare sprint report" is still shown in the Tasks list with the same values

acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the Tasks list
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly 3 rows are shown, each with the columns Title, Due date, Priority, Status

acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the Tasks list
acceptance_criteria.then: an empty-state message is shown instead of the list

acceptance_criteria.given: Tasks named "Prepare sprint report" and "Other record" exist
acceptance_criteria.when: the user types "Prepare sprint report" in the search box
acceptance_criteria.then: only the Task "Prepare sprint report" is shown in the list

acceptance_criteria.given: a Task named "Prepare sprint report" exists
acceptance_criteria.when: the user changes Title to "Prepare sprint report (edited)", clicks "Save" and reloads the page
acceptance_criteria.then: the list shows "Prepare sprint report (edited)" and no longer shows "Prepare sprint report"

acceptance_criteria.given: a Task named "Prepare sprint report" exists
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clears Title in the edit form and clicks "Save"
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not saved, an error message is shown and the list still shows "Prepare sprint report"

acceptance_criteria.given: a Task named "Prepare sprint report" exists and the list shows N records
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks "Delete" on it and confirms
acceptance_criteria.then: "Prepare sprint report" is removed from the list, the list shows N - 1 records, and it is still absent after reloading the page

acceptance_criteria.given: a Task named "Prepare sprint report" exists
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks "Delete" on it and cancels the confirmation
acceptance_criteria.then: "Prepare sprint report" is still shown in the list

clarification_questions.question: Do you want to group tasks into categories or projects?
clarification_questions.reason: Categories would add a second entity.
clarification_questions.suggested_default: No categories in the first version.

assumptions: The app is used by one person in one browser; data is stored in localStorage.
Every record automatically gets id, created_at and updated_at system fields.
Tasks have no sub-tasks or assignees in the MVP.
